answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 8323 Country: India Title: Kya farmaate hai Ulema e iqram, ki fax machine k zariye eid k chaand ki shahadat qabul ki jaegi.aur aisi shahadat par eid karna kaisa hoga.bara e qaram ilm o shariat ki roshni mein jawaab ataa farmaye. Question: Asllam alaikum w.w. Kya farmaate hai Ulema e iqram, ki fax machine k zariye eid k chaand ki shahadat qabul ki jaegi.aur aisi shahadat par eid karna kaisa hoga.bara e qaram ilm o shariat ki roshni mein jawaab ataa farmaye. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Jazakallah Answer ID: 8323 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2082/1665=B/1429) In order to prove the moon sighting of Eid, it is necessary to have a shahadah (witness) i.e. in case of cloud or dust, two religious and reliable men have to give shahadah (witness) of sighting the moon personally. The moon sighting information through fax is unacceptable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
